# Keep the authored source normal and data images unchanged. Verify actual ARM blue channel.
import numpy as np
arm=bpy.data.images.load(str(P/'source/Original_ARM_4K.png'),check_existing=False);arm.colorspace_settings.name='Non-Color';pixels=np.empty(len(arm.pixels),np.float32);arm.pixels.foreach_get(pixels);blue=pixels[2::4]
report['original_arm_metallic_range']=[float(blue.min()),float(blue.max())]
if float(blue.max())!=0:raise RuntimeError('Expected zero source metalness; revisit channel extraction')
bpy.data.images.remove(arm);del pixels,blue
report['source_crop_pixels']=[1280,0,3120,4096];report['source_tile_m']=2.5;report['crop_to_leaf_scale']=[1.192/(1840/4096*2.5),2.584/2.5]
report['source_only_proof']='Original BaseColor/Roughness/Normal unchanged; Metallic extracted from original zero ARM B; no synthetic weathering or displacement'
